4th Period.workingNow: Building your home page — one image and a menu linking to your other pages — and learning what PII is so you know what NOT to put on it.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub repository live on GitHub Pages with a home page (single image + page menu) and at least one content page — first name only, no other personal info.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can build a home page with one image and a page menu, and explain what personal information (PII) I should never put on a public site.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions on a range of social and academic topics.
agenda: Timed transition begins today — note your time (3 min)
I do: model a home page — one image + menu linking to pages (8 min)
We do: discuss what PII is and why our repo is public (8 min)
You do: build your home page — first name only, no age/location — then turn in your link on Google Classroom (12 min)
Exit Ticket — Whip-Around: one example of PII to avoid (5 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday we learned our tools. Today we set our classroom norms and start our home page — since it's public, we're also learning what to keep off of it. Tomorrow we start building out our other pages.
